# High Latency in Grand Tunis due to Stadium Event Congestion

- **Classification:** expected_event
- **Root cause:** expected_event at `S-TUN-001`
- **Confidence:** high (The timing of the stadium event precisely matches the onset of anomalies and KPI deviations. Maintenance windows, configuration changes, and transport failures were checked and ruled out across affected sites and their parents.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-17 17:30 to 2026-09-17 21:13
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-17 17:31
- **Affected:** S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, S-TUN-006

## Summary

A football match at Stade Olympique de Rades (EVT-003) drove a massive surge in active users, data volume, and PRB utilization, causing localized capacity congestion and high latency across nearby sites in Grand Tunis.

High latency and congestion affected multiple sites in Grand Tunis starting around 2026-09-17 17:30, completely clearing up after the match concluded and PRB utilization warnings cleared by 2026-09-17 21:13.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-17 12:00: Monitoring window opened for external events, changes, and maintenance checks. [T2, T4, T8]
- 2026-09-17 17:30: Earliest KPI deviation onset detected with S-TUN-006 latency_ms rising above baseline, alongside detector alerts. [T1, T3, ALR-0019]
- 2026-09-17 17:31: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades begins (EVT-003). [EVT-003]
- 2026-09-17 17:34: Warning alarm HIGH_PRB raised on S-TUN-006 (ALM-000349). [ALM-000349]
- 2026-09-17 17:45: Ended alert ALR-0020 triggered for S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, and S-TUN-003. [ALR-0020]
- 2026-09-17 18:39: Warning alarm HIGH_PRB raised on S-TUN-001 (ALM-000356). [ALM-000356]
- 2026-09-17 20:42: Football match at Stade Olympique de Rades ends. [EVT-003]
- 2026-09-17 21:09: HIGH_PRB warning alarm on S-TUN-001 clears. [ALM-000356]
- 2026-09-17 21:13: HIGH_PRB warning alarm on S-TUN-006 clears, marking the end of impact. [ALM-000349]

## Evidence

- A football match took place at Stade Olympique de Rades starting at 2026-09-17 17:31. [EVT-003]
- Sites S-TUN-001, S-TUN-002, S-TUN-003, and S-TUN-006 experienced severe KPI spikes in active users, download volume, PRB utilization, drop rate, and latency. [T3, ALR-0019, ALR-0020, ANM-000221, ANM-000222, ANM-000223, ANM-000229, ANM-000234, ANM-000235]
- No maintenance windows or configuration changes occurred on the affected sites or their parent nodes during the incident window. [T4, T8]
- Alarms raised were limited to high PRB utilization warnings (ALM-000349, ALM-000356) with no critical or major transport or hardware failures. [T6]

## Inferences

- The high latency was a direct result of capacity congestion driven by the external stadium event. [EVT-003, T3, ALM-000349, ALM-000356]

## Hypotheses

1. **expected_event** at S-TUN-001: confirmed. The timing of the football match perfectly aligns with the onset of high traffic and high latency spikes across nearby sites. Maintenance and changes were ruled out, and alarms only showed localized high PRB usage. [EVT-003, T3, T4, T6, T8]
2. **transport_failure**: rejected. Topology and alarm checks showed no critical or major alarms on transport links or aggregation routers, and fiber links were fully operational. [T5, T6, T7]
3. **bad_change**: rejected. Change log verification confirmed zero changes scheduled or applied on the affected sites or their parent nodes during the time window. [T8]

## Ruled out

- T4: No maintenance window was scheduled on the affected sites or their parent nodes, ruling out maintenance as a cause.
- T8: No configuration changes were made on the affected sites or their parents during the window, ruling out bad changes.

## Recommended actions

- Monitor high-density venues like Stade Olympique de Rades proactively for major events

confounders.why: A real stadium event the same evening in the same region, but its venue is about 7 km from S-TUN-006; it explains the venue sites, not this site.
HIGH_PRB at a venue site, caused by the event.

truth.notes: trap=congestion_on_match_day; Demand surge saturated the radio resources of S-TUN-006, 7 km from the stadium; the match is real but is not the cause. Trap: a stadium event is on the calendar for the region and the evening, so a hasty investigator calls the congestion at S-TUN-006 expected. Settled by: (1) S-TUN-006 is not a venue site (near_venue is false, about 7 km away, under LNK-TUN-02-A while the venue sites hang under other links), and the event record names the venue; (2) latency and drop rate at the site are far worse than at the venue sites, whose extra capacity keeps them mild; (3) the runbook says an event far from the saturated site does not explain it.
